source: Installed Stardew Valley.dll decompiled locally with ilspycmd 9.1.0.7988; no external translation source.

confirmed.finding: LetterViewerMenu and LevelUpMenu load LearnedRecipe_cooking or LearnedRecipe_crafting and insert it into the recipe templates. Dutch kook/maak + {0}recept is correct.
CarpenterMenu inserts Blueprint.GetDisplayNameForBuildingToUpgrade into the hover label; Verbetering van {0} describes the required base building.
GameLocation inserts Lexicon.getTokenizedPossessivePronoun(Game1.player.IsMale) into {1}; use Dutch zijn/haar through the Lexicon asset.

PondQueryMenu uses display names without plural inflection for mod languages. Dutch quantity templates explicitly use {1}× {0}; the one-item branch uses 1. This preserves numerical quantity and avoids incorrect plural grammar without inventing item forms.
CharacterCustomization supplies Lexicon.getProperArticleForWord as {0}. It is empty for all non-English languages, so Dutch can keep {0} directly adjacent to {1} inside its compound noun.
Multiplayer.receiveChatInfoMessage expands aOrAn: via Utility.AOrAn; this returns literal a/an for mod languages. Keeping all source placeholders requires a Dutch-only runtime patch returning een.
confirmed.requiredAction: Patch Utility.AOrAn only while CurrentLanguageCode is mod and CurrentModLanguage.LanguageCode is nl-vnrevival. Test Dutch and unchanged other languages, then apply the two currently deferred UI translations.
confirmed.resolution: Implemented AfterIndefiniteArticle in the shared language switcher, guarded by mod + nl-vnrevival. Built with zero errors/warnings; VNRevivalDutchProbe on .NET 6.0.32 x64 passed nine actual Harmony calls. Both UI translations applied.

confirmed.finding: Dialogue substitutes uninflected random adjectives and nouns. English assets contain %adj in MarriageDialogue:Indoor_Day_3; %noun also occurs in Abigail:fall_Thu and MarriageDialogueMaru:Outdoor_2/Good_6. Dutch dialogue must use predicative adjective constructions or noun naming to work for both de/het nouns without changing tokens.
confirmed.requiredFollowThrough: Apply this constraint when translating the four containing dialogue entries, then validate sample substitutions.
